from pathlib import Path
import struct,zlib
for name, exif_payload in [('zero_exif.png', b''), ('bad_exif.png', b'ABCD')]:
    png=bytearray(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
    def chunk(t,d):
        png.extend(struct.pack('>I',len(d)))
        png.extend(t)
        png.extend(d)
        crc=zlib.crc32(t)
        crc=zlib.crc32(d,crc)&0xffffffff
        png.extend(struct.pack('>I',crc))
    chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
    chunk(b'eXIf', exif_payload)
    raw=b'\x00\xff\x00\x00\xff'
    chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw))
    chunk(b'IEND', b'')
    Path(name).write_bytes(png)
    print(name, len(png))
